display_title: A World of Cats and Me
description:
"Everyone in the world looks like a cat?!"

Somi has returned to the past with a unique ability: she sees every human being as a feline. Determined to live her life again—this time free from the prejudices of physical appearance, she encounters two very special cats... or rather, two men.

How far can a love triangle between a human and "cats" actually go? 

It’s a love triangle featuring a woman who finds everyone adorable now that her superficial biases are gone, and the two cats vying for her heart.
